# Wellness Trend Reviews

## Reviews

- [BreathiZen Review](https://wellnesstrendreviews.fun/breathizen-review-org/): BreathiZen is a respiratory support dietary supplement in an oral spray, with a 154 mg proprietary blend of Mullein Leaf Extract (10:1), Ginger Root Extract and Organic Lemon Extract; four sprays once a day, 2 oz (60 ml) in each bottle, 60-day guarantee.
